string.text: Rail fastening
Allows you to install various types of sights on weapons.
Barrel bluing
A special heat-resistant coating makes the weapon barrel more resistant to adverse environmental conditions, increasing the reliability of the weapon.
Soft descent
Allows you to increase the rate of fire.
Improved cutoff
Modification of the cartridge ejection system reduces the likelihood of delays during shooting.
Rifled barrel
Rifling the barrel can significantly improve shooting accuracy and increases the initial speed of the bullet, but makes it impossible to fire shotguns.
Lightweight parts
Replacing standard weapon parts with lightweight analogues made from modern alloys makes it possible to reduce the weight of weapons.
Tactical module
Installation of a special tactical unit on a weapon, which combines the functions of a laser target designator and a tactical flashlight.An indispensable thing for fighting at night.
Plastic drum
A drum made of modern wear-resistant plastic allows you to reduce the weight of the weapon without compromising its other characteristics.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Folding stock
By installing the buttstock, it becomes much easier for the shooter to parry recoil.
Recoil compensator
The introduction of a special polymer damper into the design of the weapon makes it possible to slightly reduce the recoil felt by the shooter.
Anatomical handle
Provides the right hand with a more comfortable grip.
